story_overview: After Bjorn kills a man in The Kill Room, Chloe works to override a security system from her Hacker's Nest. Meanwhile, Dr. Aris investigates a series of mysterious objects, before Bjorn witnesses another murder, recoiling in shock as blood splatters against a glass window in front of him.

video_prompts:
Bjorn: Muscular, shirtless man with longish curly red hair, a full beard, glasses, and a black Valknut tattoo on his chest.
The Kill Room: An interior room featuring a wall covered in blood splatters.
the fresh blood splatter: A fresh splatter of glossy, bright red blood with an irregular shape and radiating droplets and streaks.
the victim's body: The body of an older man with a white beard and a gruesome, bloody wound on his neck.

In The Kill Room, the fresh blood splatter sprays across the wall as the victim's body slides down it, coming to a rest on the floor. Bjorn stands over the victim's body, breathing heavily as he looks down at it.
action_descriptions: In The Kill Room, the fresh blood splatter sprays across the wall as the victim's body slides down it, coming to a rest on the floor. Bjorn stands over the victim's body, breathing heavily as he looks down at it.

video_prompts:
Javier: A man with short dark hair and a light beard, wearing a black collared shirt.
Chloe: Woman with long, curly hair, wearing a pale yellow tank top and dark pants.
The Hacker's Nest: Dark room containing a desk with a computer monitor displaying a green text-based hacking interface and a keyboard.

Over Javier's shoulder, a medium close-up of Chloe sitting at a desk in The Hacker's Nest, wearing the tactical face mask. The only light comes from the glowing green text of the hacking interface screen, which illuminates her hands. She holds the single sheet of paper in one hand and types on the keyboard with the other.

video_prompts:
The Blasted Warehouse: A large, dark-colored building with a ragged hole blown through one of its exterior walls.
the locked security door: A door with a cracked glass panel, featuring a mounted high-tech security system that has a screen with the luminous text 'DOOR LOCK ACTIVATED', an illuminated red light, and a blue-lit keypad.
the active door lock: High-tech security system featuring a digital screen that displays the text 'DOOR LOCK ACTIVATED' in glowing letters, an illuminated red light, and a blue-lit keypad.

Close-up shot inside The Blasted Warehouse at night. Bjorn leans closer to the locked security door, studying the active door lock. The screen glows with the text 'DOOR LOCK ACTIVATED' and its red light is illuminated.

Dr. Aris: Man with a beard and glasses, wearing a light blue lab coat over a white shirt and a dark tie.
The Access Point: A brick wall with a mounted, dark-colored, high-tech security keypad featuring an illuminated digital screen and a red backlight integrated into its casing.

Close-up on The Access Point, a security keypad mounted on a brick wall in a dark setting. Its screen displays the text 'DOOR LOCK ACTIVATED' and a red backlight glows from its casing. Dr. Aris leans in to get a better look at the screen.

The Glass Corridor: An office corridor with a doorway and a large exterior glass window.

Medium shot of Dr. Aris wearing the black-framed glasses, standing inside The Glass Corridor. He glances down at the small handheld device, his fingers tapping on its surface. Behind him, the large interior window looks out into another dimly lit office.

Kai: Person of unspecified gender wearing a dark hooded jacket and a face mask.

In the dimly lit Glass Corridor, Bjorn stands up, adjusting the dark necktie where it is draped over his bare shoulder. Kai stands in the doorway watching him, shifting their weight slightly. Outside, rain streaks down the rain-streaked windows.
